pattern: に気がつく（にきがつく）
keywords: Noun + に気がつく; plain clause + のに気がつく.
After getting home, I noticed I had left something behind.
I noticed that the window was open.
formation: Noun + に気がつく; plain clause + のに気がつく.
restrictions: Focuses on the moment of noticing rather than long-standing knowledge.
mistake: A clause needs nominalization before に.

segments.role: Describe becoming aware of something. Noun + に気がつく; plain clause + のに気がつく.
